scope: 423 ordered RAM-injected poses per ROM, stock NTSC Mesen. Baseline captured in two batches (339 original poses plus84 additional30px boundary cases). Enemy AI deliberately held still; sizing history preserved between frames and poses. Projection, rasterization, upload and display execute actual linked ROM opcodes. Not a controller-only route or physical-console test.
limitations: Sprite sizes remain discrete. Hysteresis prevents toggling near a threshold; it does not create continuous scaling.
Timing controls compare the same rendered size and pose. An intermediate larger sprite can intrinsically cost more to render than the old smaller tier.
The camera-forward floor anchor remains unchanged. This task does not change the previously observed vertical clipping when looking obliquely at extremely close actors.
